title: Averaging after replacing a marginal
statement: Let $D$ be a finite domain, let a constraint template have finitely many predicates, and let $c$ be a constraint whose scope is an ordered tuple of distinct variables. For each variable $v$, let $P_v$ be a probability distribution on $D$, and suppose the variable $z$ occurs in the scope of $c$. For each label $a\in D$, replace $P_z$ by the point mass at $a$, leaving the other distributions unchanged, and let $q(a)$ be the probability that $c$ is satisfied when its scoped variables are drawn independently from these distributions. Then the expectation of $q(a)$ when $a$ is drawn from $P_z$ equals the original probability that $c$ is satisfied under independent draws from the distributions $P_v$.
hypotheses_covered: Constraint c over the template and variable set
Finite scope of c with pairwise-distinct variables
Probability distribution on D for each variable
Variable z belongs to the range of c's scope
